data.title: GSK Transfers 22,000,000 Treasury Shares to Procure 11,000,000 ADRs
data.description:
GlaxoSmithKline ( (GSK) ) has provided an update.

GSK is a global biopharma company whose stated purpose is to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

On November 20, 2026, GSK transferred 22,000,000 treasury-held ordinary shares to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., the depositary for its American depositary receipts programme, to procure the issuance and transfer of 11,000,000 ADRs to the GlaxoSmithKline (US) Trust. The ADRs were to be used to satisfy awards under the Deferred Annual Bonus Plan, Performance Share Plan and Share Value Plan.

The consideration received was $47.82 per ADR, or $23.91 per ordinary share, and was funded by a contribution to the Trust from GlaxoSmithKline LLC. Following the transfer, GSK will hold 248,881,064 ordinary shares in treasury and have 4,067,451,066 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares; treasury shares will represent 6.12% of voting rights.

data.title: Fitness Champs Closes Approximately $5 Million Public Offering
data.description:
Fitness Champs Holdings Limited ( (FCHL) ) has issued an update.

Fitness Champs Holdings Limited is a Singapore aquatic sports education provider offering swimming lessons for children and adults, including ladies-only classes, competitive swimming and lifesaving. Its market focus includes Singapore public schools through the Ministry of Education’s SwimSafer program and private lessons under the Fitness Champs brand.

On November 20, 2026, the company announced the closing of a best-efforts public offering expected to generate approximately $5 million in gross proceeds before fees and expenses. The offering comprised 14,285,715 units containing a Class A ordinary share or pre-funded warrant and a warrant; if all warrants were exercised under the zero-exercise-price option, the company would issue 214,285,725 shares without additional consideration.

The company said it believed the offering proceeds raised stockholders’ equity above Nasdaq’s $2.5 million requirement, addressing a deficiency first reported on May 26, 2026. Nasdaq’s final compliance determination remained subject to review, and the company could face delisting if it failed to demonstrate compliance in a future periodic report.

data.title: Jaguar Animal Health Announces 1-for-25 Reverse Stock Split
data.description:
Jaguar Animal Health ( (JAGX) ) has provided an update.

At its November 6, 2026, special meeting, Jaguar stockholders approved an amendment authorizing a reverse split ratio from 1-for-2 to 1-for-150, with the board selecting the ratio. On November 18, Jaguar filed an amendment providing for the board-approved 1-for-25 split, then terminated it on November 19 before it took effect and filed a replacement amendment with the same terms and a November 24 effective time.

Under the replacement amendment, every 25 shares would be reclassified as one, with proportional adjustments to outstanding options, warrants and equity-plan reserves; authorized common and preferred shares would remain unchanged. On November 20, Jaguar announced the split and said it was intended to support Nasdaq listing compliance; fractional shares would be paid in cash, while street-name holders would not need to act.

data.title: Ardagh Metal Packaging Prices €1,300 Million Senior Secured Floating-Rate Green Notes
data.description:
Ardagh Metal Packaging ( (AMBP) ) has provided an announcement.

Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) is a global supplier of sustainable and infinitely recyclable metal beverage cans to brand owners. Its operations span Europe and the Americas, with 23 production facilities in nine countries and innovative production capabilities focused on the beverage can industry.

On November 20, 2026, AMP priced €1,300 million of senior secured floating-rate green notes. The proceeds were intended to fund redemption of its $600 million and €450 million senior secured green notes due in 2028, along with general corporate purposes including capital expenditure; AMP said the refinancing diversified its investor base, made September 2029 its earliest senior green-note maturity and supported previously announced capacity expansion projects in Spain and the UK.

data.title: Nouveau Monde Graphite Receives NYSE Price-Compliance Notice
data.description:
The latest update is out from Nouveau Monde Mining ( (TSE:NOU) ).

Nouveau Monde Graphite is developing responsible mining and advanced processing operations to supply carbon-neutral advanced graphite materials to industries including energy, advanced technology and manufacturing. On November 18, 2026, the company received written notice from the NYSE that its shares had not met the exchange’s US$1.00 average closing-price requirement over 30 consecutive trading days.

The notice did not affect the company’s operations, its immediate NYSE listing or trading, or its compliance status on the Toronto Stock Exchange, although NYSE trading remained subject to other continued-listing standards. The company was given six months from receiving the notice to regain compliance under the exchange’s stated closing-price tests.

data.title: Chaince Digital Forms Subsidiary to Pursue AI Data Centers
data.description:
An update from Chaince Digital Holdings Inc ( (CD) ) is now available.

On November 19, 2026, Chaince Digital Holdings announced the formation of Chaince Compute Inc., a Delaware-incorporated, wholly owned subsidiary incorporated on November 2, 2026, to pursue U.S. artificial intelligence data center projects. Its planned approach would target small and mid-sized facilities of up to 100 megawatts each, use modular construction with a target build period of under 12 months, and combine grid power with sources such as solar and energy storage.

Chaince Compute intended to identify sites with existing or obtainable power capacity, including cryptocurrency mining facilities that could be converted into AI data centers. It planned to work with site owners and power-capacity holders through joint ventures or other structures while negotiating with prospective tenants; Chaince Digital had previously operated a U.S. Filecoin distributed storage business from 2022 to 2026 using third-party data center services.

data.title: Boxlight Faces Nasdaq Delisting Notice Over Equity Deficiency
data.description:
Boxlight ( (BOXL) ) has issued an update.

On November 18, 2026, the SEC declared effective Boxlight’s registration statement covering the resale by selling stockholders of up to 47,466,613 Class A common shares, including shares issuable under the Series D preferred stock and equity line of credit. The effectiveness satisfied a key condition for the second tranche of the Series D financing and use of an equity line of credit of up to $15 million; funding of the second tranche remained subject to remaining closing conditions.

Also on November 18, 2026, Nasdaq notified Boxlight that its approximately $1.9 million in stockholders’ equity, reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was below the $2.5 million minimum required for continued listing. The notice stated that trading could be suspended on November 30 unless Boxlight requested a hearing by November 25; a timely request would stay the suspension, while the company’s Class A common stock continued trading pending the Panel’s decision.

data.title: CaliberCos Publishes Inaugural Investor FAQ for Shareholders
data.description:
CaliberCos, Inc. Class A ( (CWD) ) has shared an update.

On November 20, 2026, Caliber published its inaugural investor FAQ, answering 67 questions about its business model, two businesses, plans and objectives, balance sheet and stock. The FAQ used plain English, cited the relevant filings or releases and dates for figures, and included new detail on real estate Caliber owned directly or had invested in.

Caliber furnished the FAQ to the Securities and Exchange Commission and said it was intended to provide company information for prospective shareholders, rather than sales material for private funds or a prediction of the stock price. The FAQ also addressed the distinction between publicly traded stock and private fund investments, which have different risks, liquidity profiles and return drivers.

data.title: BILL Holdings Agrees to $6 Billion Acquisition by TPG
data.description:
Bill.com Holdings ( (BILL) ) has shared an announcement.

On November 19, 2026, BILL Holdings agreed to be acquired by entities affiliated with TPG, with Corpay as a direct or indirect investor. The all-cash transaction values BILL at approximately $6.0 billion and provides $63.25 per share, a 31% premium to its 60-day volume-weighted average price ending November 16.

BILL’s board unanimously approved the agreement and recommended stockholder adoption; holders representing approximately 11.1% of voting power agreed to support it. Completion is subject to stockholder approval, antitrust and other regulatory clearances, and customary conditions, while Parent’s financing is not a closing condition.

The agreement provides cash treatment for outstanding options and equity awards, subject to their terms. It also includes a $180.51 million company termination fee and a $421.18 million Parent termination fee in specified circumstances.
